einvoice.title: E-invoices (Mắt Bão)
einvoice.remaining: {count, plural, one {# number left} other {# numbers left}}
einvoice.intro: Issue VAT invoices under the hotel's tax ID, through the hotel's Mắt Bão account. Until it is connected, keep issuing invoices in the invoicing software you already use; bookings and revenue are still recorded as usual.
einvoice.modeManual: Manual: front desk or accounting presses Issue on each booking
einvoice.modeManualHint: Nothing is issued by itself. Create the invoice for a booking, then press Issue once it has been checked.
einvoice.modeAuto: Automatic: issued as soon as a booking is fully paid
einvoice.modeAutoHint: As soon as a booking is paid in full (PayOS, a confirmed transfer, cash), an invoice for the booking total is issued. Applies to bookings fully paid after you choose it; nothing is issued while only part is paid; if the company details are invalid, the invoice waits for staff to fix them.
einvoice.emailInvoices: Email the invoice (PDF) to the buyer after it is issued
einvoice.webhookHint: To get the tax office's status (code issued / rejected), send this address to Mắt Bão support. It contains a secret code: do not share it anywhere else.
einvoice.formHint: Get these details from Mắt Bão (or your accountant). The series changes every year, e.g. {example} for this year. The VAT rate is your hotel accountant's call; room prices are treated as VAT-inclusive.

bank.descriptionVietqr: Manage bank accounts to receive VietQR payments
bank.description: Manage bank accounts to receive payments
bank.infoText: Send your account number or QR code (Download QR button) to the guest by Zalo or email. These transfers are not confirmed automatically: when the money arrives, go to Payments, open (or create) the booking's payment and press Mark as paid; the revenue then counts in your reports. To have payments confirmed automatically, connect PayOS below.

payos.title: Online payments (PayOS)
payos.intro: Guests scan the code and transfer straight into the hotel's account; payments confirm themselves, no statement matching needed.
payos.step1: Sign in to my.payos.vn and create (or choose) a payment channel linked to the hotel's bank account.
payos.step2: In that channel, open the integration details and copy the Client ID, API Key and Checksum Key.
payos.step3: Paste them here. The system registers its notification address with PayOS by itself.
payos.confirmDisconnect: Disconnect PayOS? Links already sent to guests will no longer confirm themselves.

depositMode.percentOff: No online deposit now: set a deposit on the Policies page to turn it on.
depositMode.deadline: Bookings without the deposit after {time} are cancelled.
depositMode.manualWhat: Guests scan a VietQR into the hotel’s own bank account or MoMo wallet, then press “I have transferred”.
depositMode.manualDo: The hotel checks the account and, once the money is in, presses “Confirm money received” on the booking.
depositMode.payosWhat: Guests scan a PayOS code; the booking confirms itself when the money arrives, no statement to check.
depositMode.payosDo: The hotel creates a PayOS account and enters its keys in the PayOS card below.
depositMode.noAccount: No receiving account yet: add a bank account or MoMo wallet below. Until then guests pay no deposit and the hotel contacts them.
depositMode.payosFallback: PayOS is disconnected: guests transfer manually to the account below for now.
